translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yaubada ikamogi tapwarorula tokolu
E mimilisi kasi tokugwa mina Isireli imakaiagusi ikatupoiyaigusi paila Guyau nanola.
E oluvi Guyau ilukwaigu kawala,
“Yoku tau, ka - matausina tauwau bogwa eitaki ninasi tokolu e si taimamila baisa minasina ivakadi matausina imitugagasi. Matausina idokaisi mwada yeigu bavitakauloki si nigada ke?

“Ka baisa tuta kulivala baisa matausina e kuluki avaka yeigu, Guyau Yaubada lalilivala baisa matausina. Komwaidosi mina Isireli availa availa bogwa eitaki ninasi minasina tokolu e itagwalasi eivakadaisi bimitugagasi, e oluvi bimakaiasi tovitoubobuta binevaisi mapula si nigada, ka - yeigu bavitakauloki matausina. Mapula baluki makawala avaka bibodi tokolu minasina bilagaisi!
Tokolu minasina eivigaki mina Isireli itotubulokaigusi, mitaga metoya ulo bigatona yeigu apipikwaku bakaimilivau mina Isireli bininavilasi baisa yeigu.
“Baisa tuta kusali ulo biga baisa mina Isireli avaka yeigu, Guyau Yaubada lalilivala, kawagu, ‘Kuninavilasi e kuligaiwaisi minasina mi tokolu kabokakayuwa.’

“E avai tuta wala taitala yokomi mina Isireli kaina taitala togilagala eisisu olumoulela omi boda mina Isireli bitotubulokaigu e bitemmaliga minasina tokolu e oluvi bila ikatupoi baisa taitala tovitoubobuta, yeigu Guyau baluki matauna avaka mapula la katupoi!
Yeigu bapoisivisi matauna. Yeigu bavigaki matauna si kabogigisa tomota. Yeigu bakaliyabi matauna metoya osi boda ulo tomota, e igagabila komwaidona wala bukunikolaisi yeigu wala Guyau.
“E kidamwa avai tovitoubobuta wala bisipulokaisi e matauna bisipulokaimi mapula mi katupoi; ka, uula yeigula lasipuloki matauna. Yeigu bakaliyabi matauna metoya osi boda mina Isireli.
Tovitoubobuta matauna deli tokatupoi matauna bamipuki makawala wala kasi mipuki.

Yeigu bavagi makawala paila bakikuloti mina Isireli taga bisilavaigusi e biyogwalaisiga titoulesi metoya osi mitugaga. Paila matausina ulo tomota, e yeigu goli si Yaubada!” Guyau Yaubada bogwa leilivala.
Nowa, Daneli, deli Yobi
E Guyau ilukwaigu kawala,
“Mwa, yoku tau, kidamwa viloutala valu bimitugaga deli gala bikamiabaigusi, yeigu bavitakaula bakatubodi kedala kʹasi leibubanaisi. Yeigu bavigaki molusaula bikimati tomota deli mauna.
E kidamwa kaina tauwau matausina kasitaitolu Nowa, Daneli,
deli Yobi eisisuaisi baisa, si mitukwaibwaila bikoli titoulesi wala si momova.” Guyau Yaubada bogwa leilivala.
“E kaina bawitali mauna nabubolodila bikamataisi tomota, e bavigaki minasina bivakulotaisi mapilana e bavigaki tomota bisilali uwosi tuvaila, e gala bililoulasi mapilana,

e ilagoli matausina kasitaitolu bisisuaisi baisa - matausina gala wala gagabila bikolaisi si momova litusia. Ka, yeigu Guyau Yaubada lalilivala, yeigu Yaubada Tomomova goli! Matausina bikolaisi si momova titoulesi wala, e valu mapilana bimila viloupakala wala.
“Kaina bamai kabilia ovalu mavilouna e bimtulaisi komwaidona tomota deli mauna,
e kasitaitolu bisisuaisi baisa - matausina gala wala ibodi bikolaisi litusia si momova. Ka, yeigu Guyau Yaubada lalilivala, yeigu Yaubada Tomomova goli! Matausina bikolaisi si momova titoulesi wala.
“Kidamwa bawitali kwaitala lelia bikaloubusi ovalu mavilouna e metoya ogu gibuluwa bakatudoum tomota deli mauna,

kidamwa goli Nowa, Daneli, Yobi bisisuaisi baisa, matausina gala ibodi bikolaisi litusia si momova. Ka, yeigu Guyau Yaubada lalilivala, yeigu Yaubada Tomomova goli! Matausina si mitukwaibwaila bikoli si momova titoulesi wala.”

Baisa makawala avaka Guyau Yaubada eililivala, “Yeigu bawitali ulo mipuki kwaivasi saina kwaimwaugaga bikaloubusisi Yerusalem - kabilia, molusaula, mauna nabubolodila deli lelia - makwaisina bimtulaisi tomota deli mauna.

Ka, kidamwa availa bisisu tomomova e bikoli litula, kukwatukoyavi matausina avai tuta bimakaiamsi. Kuvitusi ammakawala kala vakaila si mitugaga, e bukunikoli mipuki makwaisina bamai Yerusalem bogwa bibudoki;
e bukunikoli vavagi komwaidona avaka lavagi gala vigimakava, isim uula.” Baisa Guyau Yaubada eilivala.

footnotes.text: Matauna Daneli taitala guma Kenani, taitala tomitukwaibwaila, gala goli tovitoubobuta Daniela.
